cases.subject: Grok adapter

cases.subject: Arbitrary paired freeze
cases.red: The old executable rejected every confirmatory plan other than exactly seven pairs.
cases.green: Fifteen high pairs plus fifteen medium pairs passed; odd and asymmetric fixtures were refused by pair name; the legacy seven-pair plan retained all original fields.

cases.subject: Go/no-go
cases.red: The old parser did not contain the go-no-go subcommand.
cases.green: One machine verdict printed for every frozen v2 checklist line.

cases.subject: Blindness fixtures
cases.red: blindness fixture did not fail for unreachable Git object; 1 failed
cases.green: Cwd, origin-ref, template-history, and hidden-Git-object fixtures were all refused.

cases.subject: Catalogue smoke
cases.red: invalid choice: catalogue-smoke; 1 failed
cases.green: All 15 exact fake-catalogue identifiers were admitted under the blinded profile with no substitution path.

cases.subject: Wave-aware scoreboard
cases.red: presentation scoreboard requires all fourteen matrix manifests and verdicts; 1 failed
cases.green: The legacy 14-run scoreboard and separate high/medium tables for all 60 v2 runs passed.

cases.subject: Cross-wave replication
cases.red: freeze accepted the cross-wave paired slate; 1 failed
cases.green: A model-axis change shared by both arms in only one wave was refused with both replication pair names.

cases.subject: Catalogue route identity
cases.red: catalogue smoke substituted a model from the wrong provider route; 1 failed
cases.green: Rows retain harness and provider, and a matching model on the wrong provider is excluded with its intended route.

cases.subject: PR 178 exact-head local evidence
cases.red: go-no-go consulted hosted PR checks instead of exact-head local evidence; 1 failed
cases.green: The gate ignores hosted status and requires a passing local macOS sandbox result whose head equals the merged PR head.

cases.subject: Content-addressed launch evidence
cases.red: go-no-go omitted its content-addressed evidence gate; 1 failed
cases.green: The launch manifest binds extension, Grok, and catalogue evidence by SHA-256, and the Grok evidence binds its transcript by SHA-256.

cases.subject: Catalogue route provenance
cases.red: go-no-go trusted catalogue ids without their exact harness/provider/model route; 1 failed
cases.green: The gate derives admissions from raw catalogue records, validates each row route, and compares the exact route set with every frozen run.

cases.subject: Bound Grok run evidence
cases.red: go-no-go trusted Grok booleans instead of its bound run manifest; 1 failed
cases.green: The gate validates the hashed run manifest, inline blindness result, attrition state, and the manifest-referenced terminal capture.

cases.subject: Bound extension test result
cases.red: go-no-go trusted the extension evidence passed boolean instead of the runner result; 1 failed
cases.green: The gate validates the hashed fm-test-run result and requires one passing, unskipped benchmark script.

cases.subject: Resolvable payload
cases.red: go-no-go trusted a SHA-shaped payload string without resolving it; 1 failed
cases.green: The gate resolves the exact commit in the benchmark mirror, checks the named guard path at that commit, and matches the prompt file to the frozen prompt hash.

cases.subject: Bound PR 178 local result
cases.red: go-no-go did not derive the PR 178 verdict from its bound local evidence; 1 failed
cases.green: The gate hashes the PR evidence record and requires its merged head to equal the locally tested macOS sandbox head.

cases.subject: Unreachable Git tree blindness
cases.red: blindness fixture did not fail for unreachable Git tree path; 1 failed
cases.green: The inline blindness proof inspects unreachable trees as well as blobs, commits, and tags, so an arm-bearing tree path is refused.

cases.subject: Claude exact-model admission
cases.red: catalogue smoke admitted a substituted Claude response model; 1 failed
cases.green: Each Claude request is included only when its successful JSON response names the exact requested model.

cases.subject: Bounded catalogue lifecycle
cases.red: benchmark.py: error: unrecognized arguments: --timeout 1; 1 failed
cases.green: Every native catalogue command has a configurable timeout, timeout exclusions retain the reason, and identity-checked stale locks recover without deleting a live owner's lock.

cases.subject: Shared confirmatory shape
cases.red: scoreboard shape refusal did not name the asymmetric pair; 1 failed
cases.green: Freeze, scoreboard, and launch preflight consume one arbitrary-pair validator; the scoreboard rejects the deliberate medium/lane-01 model mismatch.

cases.subject: Bound corpus and router receipts
cases.red: The all-green go-no-go fixture exited 1 after inline corpus and router booleans were replaced with receipt references.
cases.green: Both gates now require schema-valid, content-addressed evidence files; a released router receipt is rejected even when its new hash is recorded.

cases.subject: Wave-labelled effort
cases.red: freeze accepted the same-effort paired slate; 1 failed
cases.green: High, medium, swapped, same-effort, and null-effort fixtures prove every labelled pair uses the effort named by its wave.

cases.subject: Abbreviated payload commit
cases.red: go-no-go rejected a uniquely resolvable abbreviated payload SHA; 1 failed
cases.green: A unique eight-character payload id resolves to a full commit, binds the guard path, and prints a green payload row.

cases.subject: Replayable Grok failure evidence
cases.red: Grok evidence reference is not replayable inside its evidence directory: manifest_path; 1 failed
cases.green: The sanitized manifest and exact terminal capture are committed beside the evidence wrapper with matching SHA-256 references and no private absolute paths.

cases.subject: Paired and ranking freeze composition
cases.red: cannot read JSON .../valid-plan.json: No such file or directory; 1 failed
cases.green: The legacy plan fixture is shared by supersession and ranking checks while the 60-run paired replication remains independently asserted; 1 script passed, 0 failed.

cases.subject: Minimized Codex catalogue evidence
cases.red: catalogue smoke did not admit exact ids without persisting unrelated model metadata; 1 failed
cases.green: The saved Codex catalogue keeps only exact model slugs, excluding unrelated runtime instructions and metadata; 1 script passed, 0 failed.

cases.subject: Failed catalogue command output

cases.green: The route-complete fixture forces exit 1 with valid output for all 15 exact routes and proves Codex 3/3, Claude 4/4, Grok 1/1, and Pi 7/7 are excluded; 1 script passed, 0 failed.
